{{nihongo|'''Kunihashiramikoto Shrine'''|國柱命神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

=== Overview ===
It is enshrined on the northwestern mountain foot in the center of the Iwashina Nansoku district, on the south side of the Iwashina River that crosses the Iwashina area in southeastern Matsuzaki.

Its founding is unknown, but it is an old shrine identified with the {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} of the same name, Kunihashiramikoto Shrine (くにのみはしらのみことじんじゃ), and is also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no Kuni Shinkaichō|ja|伊豆国神階帳|qid=Q17193087}}'' as "Junior Fourth Rank Upper, Kuniharahime no Myōjin"<ref name="town">[https://www.town.matsuzaki.shizuoka.jp/docs/2020120800012/ 国柱命神社] - Matsuzaki Town</ref><ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/kunihasira_title.htm 國柱命神社] - Genbu</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140314-01.html 国柱命神社] - Study of Engishiki Shrines</ref>.

In {{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}} (Meiji 6), it was listed as a village shrine<ref name="engi"/>.

Before the Edo period it was called "Iwashina no Miya" and "Shinmei-gū," and in {{ill|1885|Q7821|qid=Q7821}} (Meiji 18) it resumed the current name<ref name="town"/><ref name="engi"/>.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* Kunihashirahime-no-Mikoto
